ශ්‍රී ඼ංකා ප්‍රජාාාා්ත්‍රික සමාජාලාදී ජානරජායේ ගැසට් පත්‍රය
අති විශ඾඿
No. 2393/45 – FRIDAY, JULY 19, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
The Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: Thiprale/1/8/3/84ath. Ministry of Land Ref. No. : 4-3/20/2019/T/620.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/ servitude which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired: Acquisition of Land for Expansion of the Kelanivelli Railway track to a double track under the Colombo Suburban Railway Project:

Allotments of the Lands in extent of 0.0095 Hectares, shown a Lot Nos. 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 Plan No.P.Co. 10035 dated 10.03.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at (Division No. 41 within the Limits of Colombo Municipal Council area) Kirula Grama Niladhari Division, Narahenpita Village in the Divisional Secretariat of Thimbirigasyaya, Colombo District, Western Province. Those lands details are as follows:

01. Lot No. 01 Name of land: Kirimandala Mawatha, Assmt No. 483/17/C (Portion); Present usage of the Land: Home Garden, a portion of the permanent three storied building; Name & Address of the Claimants: Required for the double Railway Track; Extent: 0.0007 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 02 Name of land: Kirimandala Mawatha, Assmt No. 483/17/A (Portion); Present usage of the Land: Home Garden, a portion of the permanent two storied building; Name & Address of the Claimants: Required for the double Railway Track; Extent: 0.0010 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 03 Name of land: Kirimandala Mawatha, Assmt No. 483/17/B (Portion); Present usage of the Land: Home Garden, a portion of the permanent two storied building; Name & Address of the Claimants: Required for the double Railway Track; Extent: 0.0017 Hectare.
04. Lot No. 04 Name of land: - ; Present usage of the Land: Road; Name & Address of the Claimants: Required for the double Railway Track; Extent: 0.0042 Hectare.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
2 A III ශකොටව - ශ්‍රී ඼ංකා ‍රජාාාා්ත්‍රික වමාජාලා ජ ජාජරජාශඅ අති විශ඾඿ සැව ප ්‍රය - 2024.07.19 Part III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 19.07.2024
05. Lot No. 05 Name of land: Not known; Present usage of the Land: Waste Land; Name & Address of the Claimants: Required for the double Railway Track; Extent: 0.0019 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat of Thimbirigasyaya on the 29th day of August 2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 22nd day of August 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for Compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the Computation of such amount.
Priyantha Disanayake, Divisional Secretary, Thimbirigasyaya. At Divisional Secretary, Thimbirigasyaya. 01st July 2024 EOG 07 - 0179

Land Lot No. 3 has been printed in the land lot mentioned in the Land Description of the Table which was published in Sinhala and English languages in the page No.5A of the Gazette extra ordinary No. 2381/50 dated 26th of April 2024 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka instead of Land Lot No. 4. Therefore, I do hereby inform you that it is hereby amended as Land lot 4 instead of land lot 3 which was published in the notification in Sinhala and English in the above Gazette.
